scientific_integrity: Analytical derivations are complemented by a standalone, finite deterministic verifier; finite computations are not substitutes for uniform or infinite-parameter proofs. Priority is a literature-bounded best-knowledge assessment, not an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The reset-benefit critical-location theorem is local in weak activity, with sequential short- and long-persistence asymptotics. A sign reversal in the coefficient is proved, not uniqueness of the persistence crossover or finite-activity global phase boundaries. The all-activity coupling assumes full position–velocity reset with identical independent noises and reset clocks.
title: Velocity-order rigidity and a persistence-driven restart-boundary reversal in active Ornstein–Uhlenbeck search
